name: Family Film Project
description: Catch the final days of this international film festival dedicated to archive, memory, and ethnography. It's a unique opportunity to see compelling documentaries and experimental films from around the world.
longDescription:
The Family Film Project is an international film festival dedicated to exploring themes of archive, memory, and ethnography through cinema. Hosted by Batalha Centro de Cinema, the festival showcases a curated selection of documentaries and experimental films from various global origins. Its mission is to foster dialogue around personal and collective histories, cultural heritage, and the evolving nature of visual storytelling.

Visitors to the festival can expect a program of thought-provoking screenings within the historic Batalha Centro de Cinema, a notable venue in Porto. The films, primarily documentaries and experimental works, offer diverse perspectives on human experience and cultural practices. The atmosphere is generally contemplative, attracting an audience interested in art-house cinema, anthropology, and social commentary.

The festival runs until October 17, 2026, marking the final day of screenings. Ticket prices vary depending on the specific film or program. Batalha Centro de Cinema is centrally located and accessible via public transport; it is a short walk from Bolhão metro station. The event is categorized as family-friendly, indicating suitability for a broader audience.
